title: Talk to Franco about watches.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Hey, business booming?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, business booming?

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Ah, the noodle stand owner. Are you offering me a job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, the noodle stand owner. Are you offering me a job?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, not really. I heard about your hobby.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, not really. I heard about your hobby.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, not really. I heard about your hobby.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, not really. I heard about your hobby.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hi Franco. I just heard about your hobby.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi Franco. I just heard about your hobby.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hi Franco. I just heard about your hobby.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hi Franco. I just heard about your hobby.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Which one? The juggling? The crochet? The zero-g yoga?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which one? The juggling? The crochet? The zero-g yoga?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The watchmaking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The watchmaking.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The watchmaking.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The watchmaking.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: That's not a hobby!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not a hobby!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My sources told me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My sources told me...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: My sources told me...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: My sources told me...

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: That's the love of my life. That and kitchen equipment, of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the love of my life. That and kitchen equipment, of course.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I already knew that one ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I already knew that one ...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I already knew that one ...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I already knew that one ...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's the watches I'm interested in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's the watches I'm interested in.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's the watches I'm interested in.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's the watches I'm interested in.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Watches are the epitome of crafted beauty. What do you want to know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Watches are the epitome of crafted beauty. What do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This conversation didn't happen. Understood? This is all secret.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This conversation didn't happen. Understood? This is all secret.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This conversation didn't happen. Understood? This is all secret.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This conversation didn't happen. Understood? This is all secret.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Oh, wow! What kind of watch are we talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, wow! What kind of watch are we talking about?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A Long & Sons from the 21st century.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A Long & Sons from the 21st century.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A Long & Sons from the 21st century.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A Long & Sons from the 21st century.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Rings a bell?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rings a bell?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Rings a bell?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Rings a bell?

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Such timepieces don't exist anymore. They were impeccable, total perfection, the best watches ever made. This level of perfection was never reached again in all the millennia that have passed since then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Such timepieces don't exist anymore. They were impeccable, total perfection, the best watches ever made. This level of perfection was never reached again in all the millennia that have passed since then.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: But they're all lost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But they're all lost.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Would you recognize one if it were in front of you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you recognize one if it were in front of you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Would you recognize one if it were in front of you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Would you recognize one if it were in front of you?

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Yes. And I would die a happy man the next second.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. And I would die a happy man the next second.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If one of these was still around and got stolen, who would sell it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If one of these was still around and got stolen, who would sell it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If one of these was still around and got stolen, who would sell it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If one of these was still around and got stolen, who would sell it?

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: I'm a watchmaker. I'm no criminal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm a watchmaker. I'm no criminal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who sells you your parts? The cogs, the hands etc.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who sells you your parts? The cogs, the hands etc.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who sells you your parts? The cogs, the hands etc.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who sells you your parts? The cogs, the hands etc.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: I usually look on flea markets for old, cheap watches and disassemble them. But a Long & Sons would not be sold there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I usually look on flea markets for old, cheap watches and disassemble them. But a Long & Sons would not be sold there.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: There's already one person dead, you said? I would suspect organized crime. Or Corp involvement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's already one person dead, you said? I would suspect organized crime. Or Corp involvement.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: LifeCorp?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: LifeCorp?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: LifeCorp?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: LifeCorp?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who would that be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who would that be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who would that be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who would that be.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Nah. They only commit legal crimes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah. They only commit legal crimes.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: I'd probably ask a guy named Vik Ryan. He's selling all sorts of black market gear.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd probably ask a guy named Vik Ryan. He's selling all sorts of black market gear.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: But be careful. Guy's tough as nails.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But be careful. Guy's tough as nails.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Old. thousands of years. And a famous brand. Better if you don't know more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Old. thousands of years. And a famous brand. Better if you don't know more.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Old. thousands of years. And a famous brand. Better if you don't know more.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Old. thousands of years. And a famous brand. Better if you don't know more.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Watches that old just don't exist anymore. Someones trying to set you up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Watches that old just don't exist anymore. Someones trying to set you up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just investigating.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just investigating.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm just investigating.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm just investigating.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: You can stop it. They're all lost. None appeared in public or on any auction for more than 200 years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can stop it. They're all lost. None appeared in public or on any auction for more than 200 years.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who would be one in this field?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who would be one in this field?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Who would be one in this field?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Who would be one in this field?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I must be mistaken then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I must be mistaken then.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I must be mistaken then.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I must be mistaken then.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Excellent. Then I'm talking with the right person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excellent. Then I'm talking with the right person.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Excellent. Then I'm talking with the right person.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Excellent. Then I'm talking with the right person.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This must remain confidential. People are dying because of this watch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This must remain confidential. People are dying because of this watch.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This must remain confidential. People are dying because of this watch.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This must remain confidential. People are dying because of this watch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Long & Sons One Tourbillon Perpetual to be exact.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Long & Sons One Tourbillon Perpetual to be exact.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Long & Sons One Tourbillon Perpetual to be exact.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Long & Sons One Tourbillon Perpetual to be exact.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Are you kidding me right now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you kidding me right now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm serious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm serious.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm serious.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm serious.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know enough about watches to do that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know enough about watches to do that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know enough about watches to do that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know enough about watches to do that.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: This watch is a masterpiece, limited to 50 pieces in platinum. I CANNOT believe this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This watch is a masterpiece, limited to 50 pieces in platinum. I CANNOT believe this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's so special about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's so special about it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What's so special about it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What's so special about it?

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: It's a tourbillon made of over 800 parts combining a perpetual calender, flyback chronograph, grand date AND a moon phase display with a 5 day power reserve.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a tourbillon made of over 800 parts combining a perpetual calender, flyback chronograph, grand date AND a moon phase display with a 5 day power reserve.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I understand this must be very valuable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand this must be very valuable.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I understand this must be very valuable.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I understand this must be very valuable.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Incredibly. I can't believe one of these still exists.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Incredibly. I can't believe one of these still exists.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tourbillon?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tourbillon?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Tourbillon?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Tourbillon?

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Yes. It's the rotating heart of the watch. It was created to counteract positional error that comes from wearing a watch with you around all day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. It's the rotating heart of the watch. It was created to counteract positional error that comes from wearing a watch with you around all day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why is the chronograph flying back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is the chronograph flying back?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why is the chronograph flying back?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why is the chronograph flying back?

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: Haha. That's a good one. No, a flyback chronograph is a time stopping function that allows you to restart it without stopping it first. Very useful for racing... before there were timing devices accurate up to the picosecond.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha. That's a good one. No, a flyback chronograph is a time stopping function that allows you to restart it without stopping it first. Very useful for racing... before there were timing devices accurate up to the picosecond.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Very impressive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very impressive.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Very impressive.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Very impressive.

nodes.speaker: Franco Miliscent
nodes.text: As I said, this is the epitome of craftsmanship.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As I said, this is the epitome of craftsmanship.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Curzona?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Curzona?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Curzona?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Curzona?
